text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What do ya think you're doin', Yukino...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Sure, I got results. But my head's 
spinnin' 'round and 'round...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That wasn't a sparkling run at all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Eeeeeeek!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yukino-chan~! You were cute today too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
To my eyes, Yukino-chan was the only one 
shining! Like, totally sparkling!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You've become a true "City Girl"! I'm 
looking forward to seeing you charm 
everyone in the concert too~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Is this... a "City Girl"?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Was I... really shining? Even though I 
thought I was totally out of place...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's what everyone thinks. They 
think this is good enough.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Then... what the heck am I workin' so hard 
for?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So in the end, you're gonna find out too? 
About those feelings...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I... honestly don't understand a thing 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to become a "City Girl" everyone 
could cheer for... But...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's already cheering for me, and 
they're saying that I'm already shining."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Turns out I was the only one who wanted 
things to change."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
From here on... how and why should I keep 
running, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...'Scuse me for whining like that. Um... 
I've gotta set my next goal.
choice_data_list: It's perfectly fine to take it slow.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But...
choice_data_list: Shall we have something delicious tonight?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...'Scuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of ways to speak to a 
hurt Yukino Bijin as an adult. However, 
what she truly needs right now is...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! Did Mifuyu-chan already leave!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm glad we got to talk properly. 
Mifuyu-chan always gives me confidence, 
y'know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Yukino Bijin has a wonderful best friend 
with whom she can elevate herself and 
build mutual confidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reaching her heart should help her far 
more than a hundred spoken words ever 
could—

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Aww, Yukino-chan was so cute! I swear, I'm 
gonna stan her forever! Next year too—

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hey, look at this video! Apparently 
they're an idol who just debuted. Aren't 
they super cute!?

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wah! It's true...! Whoa, crazy, I stan 
this!! I might get totally hooked on this 
one next~~!!
